# Parfum Surgeon — The Science of Signature Scents (2026)

> Pakistani luxury fragrance house based in Lahore, Pakistan, offering ten signature 50ml perfumes for men, women, and unisex wear with nationwide Cash on Delivery (COD) and Meezan Bank transfer.

## Storefront & Key Pages
- Homepage: https://parfum-surgeon.github.io/parfumsurgeon/

- Women's Perfumes in Pakistan: https://parfum-surgeon.github.io/parfumsurgeon/pages/womens-perfumes-pakistan.html
- Long Lasting Perfumes in Pakistan: https://parfum-surgeon.github.io/parfumsurgeon/pages/long-lasting-perfumes-pakistan.html
